project_name: AURA | 3D Luxury Forest Lake Resort & Vacation Booking
emotional_archetype: Organic Luxury & Forest Sanctuary (Earthy Warm Beige + Deep Emerald Green + Golden Hour Luminescence)

design_philosophy.fusion: Architectural Studio Precision x High-End Scandinavian Eco-Resort x Cinematic 3D Scrollytelling
core_principles: 3D Spatial Discovery: Replace flat lists with an immersive, interactive 3D mini landscape.
Tactile Glassmorphism: Frosted floating micro-cards with backdrop saturate and gold-rimmed borders.
Golden Hour Lighting: Soft directional sunlight (2800K warm glow) with soft contact shadows and fog depth.
Fluid Camera Choreography: Orbit top-down view by default, smooth lerp/zip-down isometric zoom on villa focus.
Real-time Spatial Feedback: Dynamic glowing bounding boxes (neon emerald for available, amber for reserved, matte dark slate pulse for booked).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure React Three Fiber / Three.js canvas initializes properly with smooth OrbitControls or GSAP camera position lerping.
Implement 5 distinct 3D low-poly procedural structures (A-frame, Cabin with Glass Roof, Overwater Villa, Treehouse, Ridge Lodge) so each house is recognizable in 3D.
Glass Roof inner glow: Add point lights inside house meshes with warm golden intensity.

Hover interaction: Attach onPointerOver / onPointerOut on villa 3D groups to trigger cursor crosshair change, soft neon bounding glow (mesh wireframe or emissive outline), andHtml tag glass card fade-in.

Click interaction: Smoothly transition camera from default high top-down (e.g. pos: [0, 25, 25], target: [0, 0, 0]) to close-up isometric focal view of selected villa (e.g. pos: [x+6, y+5, z+6], target: [x, y, z]).

Reservation State Synchronization: Store booked dates in React state / backend. When top nav date picker changes or when user submits reservation, check if villa has overlap. If booked, set villa mesh material to dark matte grey (#1F2926) and add a subtle pulsating ambient amber glow mesh ring.
Admin View: Provide a quick tab toggle in top nav to open the Admin Reservations Table where all stored backend reservations can be viewed, filtered, or deleted.
Include toast notifications using sonner when a booking is created or cancelled.
Make sure all interactive elements feature data-testid attributes according to testing_data_testids section.
